record.headline: LegalZoom renamed Pro and Premium to Managed Service and Expert Service, replaced attorney access on the $249 plan with business advisors, and raised the renewal on the $299 plan from $49/mo to $99/mo.

record.read: This reverses the repackaging seen on 2 Nov. The attorney access that used to sit in the $249 plan is now reserved for the $299 plan, which also carries a higher renewal, so the same entry price buys less legal help.
record.caveat: The page has moved back and forth between these two layouts; this may be a test or a rollout still in progress.
